description: Fetch one newsletter draft or send by ID, including content, delivery counters, and lifecycle timestamps.
name: shipmail_get_newsletter

add_utm_tags.description: Whether this newsletter adds UTM tags to its links.

archive_visibility.description: public lists an email_and_website issue on the audience's newsletter website and in its Atom feed. Defaults to private on create. A website issue is always listed and an email issue never is.

visibility.description: Where the block shows and to which readers. channel: all, email (hidden on the website) or web (hidden in the email). segment_id: a segment of the issue's audience, with segment_rule in (only its readers) or not_in (everyone else). The website shows a block as a reader in no segment sees it. Membership is fixed when the send is scheduled. Welcome emails accept channel only.

body.description: Bare text or sanitized inline HTML. Allowed tags are a, b, br, code, em, i, p, s, span, strong, and u.

clicked_count.description: Unique recipients who clicked at least one tracked link, excluding link scanners. Null when track_engagement is false.

held_count.description: Subscribers held past send_limit, waiting to be sent to more.

opened_count.description: Unique recipients with at least one counted open, excluding Apple Mail Privacy Protection preloads. Null when track_engagement is false.

publish_target.description: Where the newsletter goes. email_and_website (default) sends it, and lists it on the audience's newsletter website and feed when archive_visibility is public. email is never listed on the website or feed. website is published on the website and feed when scheduled, without any email; the audience needs its website or its feed on.

send_limit.description: The limit the newsletter was scheduled with. Null sends to everyone.

styling_mode.description: styled applies Shipmail's email theme. plain sends your HTML without injected styles, width, or centering, so the reader's email client styles it.

subject_test_winner.description: a is subject, b is subject_b. Null until the test decides; a tie keeps a.

track_engagement.description: Whether this newsletter tracks opens and clicks.

view_in_browser.description: Whether the email carries a View in browser link to the issue's own page.
